t: Wearable Computer: Sensor Nyquist Desk — Simple

t: Wearable Computer: Noise Floor Analyzer — Simple
name: Wearable Computer: Noise Floor Analyzer — Simple
title: Wearable Computer: Noise Floor Analyzer — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Sensors hiss: the analyzer budgets the noise floor per sensor against the signal — the SNR at the sensor decides the system's accuracy before any algorithm. A 10:1 sensor SNR is the admission ticket.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Accelerometer SNR: 2 g signal, 5 mg noise = 400 ratio. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
